prompt: Marketing wants new product banner art made from a short text description.
tells: made from a short text description
why: Creating new images from text is image generation.
trap: Analysis describes existing images; nothing exists yet.

prompt: A game studio wants quick concept sketches of scenes that writers describe in a sentence.
why: New visual output from a description is image generation.
trap: A multimodal model reads images; this one makes them.

prompt: Generate ten different mockups of a mug design so the team can pick a favorite.
why: Generative image models create new visuals.
trap: Temperature affects variety, but the capability asked for is image generation.

prompt: Replace the plain background of a product photo with a beach scene the model creates.

why: Creating new visual content, even inside an existing image, is image generation.
trap: Detecting the product isn't the goal; making the new scene is.

why: Text in, new image out: image generation.
trap: Multimodal models take images in; generation creates them.
